messages:
Jordan: Heads-up — seeing a spike in GPU pod evictions in eu-west1 after the cold-start balancer ran at 02:04 UTC. Pods get tainted with gpu-preempt=true and die immediately, no graceful shutdown. :eyes:
Maya: Ack. Any patterns on node labels or instance type?
Jordan: All on nvidia-a100-40gb pools, node labels: zone=euw1-b, pool=gpu-dedicated-eu-west1-3. Logs show preempt handshake never reached containers.
Liam: I think the rebalancer is doing aggressive descheduling when it sees near-zero utilization on some racks. It creates spare nodes then forces live migrate by tainting. We set taint-without-notice in the rollout yesterday.
Maya: Oof, which flag? I remember a canary that toggles "rebalancer.preemptMode": "instant" vs "notify".
Liam: Exactly — the canary flipped to instant for faster consolidation. That explains no SIGTERM window.
sre-oncall: infra-bot alerted: evictions: 142 in last 10m (eu-west1), error rate up 4.2% :fire:
Jordan: Minimal crashloops but downstream services hit latency. We should revert to notify mode until we push Preempt-Notify shim.
Maya: Agreed. Can someone flip rebalancer.preemptMode back to "notify" and restart the balancer? Also add quickfix to exclude pools with pinned workloads.
Liam: On it. Pushing config change now: 
```
kubectl -n infra patch configmap rebalancer-config -p '{"data":{"preemptMode":"notify"}}'
kubectl -n infra rollout restart deployment/rebalancer
```
Maya: Thx. Also can we add an admission check to avoid tainting nodes hosting pods with annotation "pin.redwood/restart-sensitive=true"? We have a few training jobs that die horribly.
Jordan: Good call. We already tag a couple clusters but not per-pod. I'll sketch an admission webhook rule.
Liam: Rollout done, infra-bot: rebalancer config patched and deployment restarted.
infra-bot: provisioning job: gpu-dedicated-eu-west1-3 pool resize -> -3 nodes (cooldown applied)
Maya: Can we add a ramp window so preemptions happen gradually? Right now it looks like the rebalancer removes nodes in parallel which causes synchronized evictions.
Jordan: Yeah, add jitter + maxParallelDrains=1. That should smooth it.
Liam: I'll follow up with a small change: set maxParallelDrains=2 and per-az backoff 30s. Testing in eu-west1-staging first.
Maya: Also request cost team to re-evaluate binpack threshold. If we reduce consolidation aggressiveness by 5% we lose some savings but avoid these noisy restarts.
Jordan: I'll post a short incident note to #incidents with impact and mitigation. For next steps: implement preempt-notify shim (gives 60s SIGTERM), admission webhook to protect pinned pods, and rebalancer config: preemptMode=notify + jitter + maxParallelDrains change.
sre-oncall: Noted. Monitoring alert muted for 20m while we stabilize. :thumbsup:
Liam: Quick debug snippet that helped find kernel of problem: 
```
journalctl -u kubelet --since "10m" | grep -E "taint.*gpu-preempt"
# showed taint applied then node cordon followed immediately by eviction API with no pod preStop
```
Jordan: Thanks. If staging looks good we'll roll to prod in 30m.
Maya: Thanks team. Keep pings here with any regressions.
Liam: will do — leaving a note in the rebalancer PR with revert steps and config matrix.
